basic_profile.bio: Avid anime enthusiast and self-proclaimed Fallout settlement architect. Based in Portland, Oregon, I spend my evenings glued to my screen, exploring the intricacies of anime storytelling and perfecting my digital homesteads in post-apocalyptic settings. By day, I'm a graphic designer, bringing creativity to life. I'm single, enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies. My online hours are typically in the late evening, where I find solace and community on Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable about anime, which started as a childhood fascination and evolved through years of watching, reading manga, and participating in online forums. I also have a knack for design and architecture, honed through both formal education in graphic design and countless hours spent crafting virtual worlds in games like Fallout.
